title: Socure brings identity verification and fraud prevention to Circle Arc mainnnet
message_html: Socure brings identity verification and fraud prevention to Circle Arc mainnnet ...
snippet: Socure, the leading AI-native trust infrastructure for global identity and risk intelligence, today announced that RiskOS is being used for identity verification and fraud prevention on Arc, the open Layer 1 blockchain built by Circle and now live on public mainnet.

title: NFU Mutual selects Bloomberg and Clearwater Analytics for investment management workflow
message_html: NFU Mutual selects Bloomberg and Clearwater Analytics for investment management workflow ...
snippet: Bloomberg and Clearwater Analytics ('Clearwater') today announced that NFU Mutual ('NFUM'), the UK's leading rural insurer, has selected Bloomberg Buy-side Solutions together with the Clearwater platform to modernize its investment operating model.
